examples.translation: He studied Chinese for a year.

examples.chinese: 我看了一个晚上书。
examples.pinyin: wǒ kàn le yī gè wǎnshàng shū 。
examples.translation: I read the book for one night.

examples.chinese: 他做了八年经理。
examples.pinyin: tā zuò le bā nián jīnglǐ 。
examples.translation: He has been a manager for eight years.

examples.chinese: 我们坐了十五个小时的飞机。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zuò le shíwǔ gè xiǎoshí de fēijī 。
examples.translation: We flew for fifteen hours.

examples.chinese: 奶奶看了一天的电视。
examples.pinyin: nǎinǎi kàn le yī tiān de diànshì 。
examples.translation: Grandma watched TV all day.

title: Expressing ongoing duration with double le
titleVi: Expressing ongoing duration with double le
structure: Subj. + Verb + 了 + Duration + 了
usedFor: Referring to the past, Expressing duration, Expressing time and date

examples.chinese: 你睡了一天了。
examples.pinyin: nǐ shùi le yī tiān le 。
examples.translation: You have slept all day.

examples.chinese: 他在北京住了两年了。
examples.pinyin: tā zài běijīng zhù le liǎng nián le 。
examples.translation: He has lived in Beijing for two years.

examples.chinese: 这个会，他们开了两个小时了。
examples.pinyin: zhè gè hùi，tāmen kāi le liǎng gè xiǎoshí le 。
examples.translation: At this meeting, they had two hours.

examples.chinese: 我在这儿等了半个小时了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài zhèér děng le bàn gè xiǎoshí le 。
examples.translation: I have been waiting here for half an hour.

examples.chinese: 他们在酒吧待了一个晚上了。
examples.pinyin: tāmen zài jǐuba dài le yī gè wǎnshàng le 。
examples.translation: They spent the night in the bar.

title: Inability with mei banfa
usedFor: Describing actions, Indicating conditions, Expressing impossibility

examples.chinese: 今天太忙了，中午没办法出去吃饭。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān tài máng le，zhōngwǔ méi bànfǎ chūqù chīfàn 。
examples.translation: Today is too busy to eat out at noon.

examples.chinese: 他没带手机，没办法给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: tā méi dài shǒujī，méi bànfǎ gěi wǒ dǎdiànhuà 。
examples.translation: He didn't bring his cell phone, he couldn't call me.

examples.chinese: 没有水，我们没办法洗衣服。
examples.pinyin: méiyǒu shǔi，wǒmen méi bànfǎ xǐ yīfú 。
examples.translation: Without water, we can't wash clothes.

examples.chinese: 这里太吵了，我没办法工作。
examples.pinyin: zhèlǐ tài chǎo le，wǒ méi bànfǎ gōngzuò 。
examples.translation: It's too noisy here, I can't work.

examples.chinese: 他不开门，所以她没办法进去。
examples.pinyin: tā bù kāimén，suǒyǐ tā méi bànfǎ jìnqù 。
examples.translation: He didn't open the door, so she couldn't get in.

examples.chinese: 你看看。
examples.pinyin: nǐ kànkàn 。
examples.translation: Take a look.

examples.chinese: 我试试。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shì shì 。
examples.translation: Let me try.

examples.chinese: 说说你的想法。
examples.pinyin: shuō shuō nǐ de xiǎngfǎ 。
examples.translation: Tell me your thoughts.

examples.chinese: 出去玩玩吧！
examples.pinyin: chūqù wán wán ba！
examples.translation: Go out and play!

examples.chinese: 我想出去走走。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng chūqù zǒu zǒu 。
examples.translation: I want to go for a walk.

examples.chinese: 我很想你。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎng nǐ 。
examples.translation: I miss you.

examples.chinese: 他很喜欢你。
examples.pinyin: tā hěn xǐhuān nǐ 。
examples.translation: He likes you very much.

examples.chinese: 你应该很小心。
examples.pinyin: nǐyìnggāihěn xiǎoxīn 。
examples.translation: You should be very careful.

examples.chinese: 我很怕晚上一个人在家。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hěn pà wǎnshàng yīgèrén zàijiā 。
examples.translation: I'm scared to be alone at night.

examples.chinese: 你应该很了解自己的孩子。
examples.pinyin: nǐ yìnggāi hěn lejiě zìjǐ de háizǐ 。
examples.translation: You should know your child well.

title: Direction complement
usedFor: Describing actions, Expressing movement, Describing places

examples.chinese: 我在楼上，你上来。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài lóushàng ，nǐ shànglái 。
examples.translation: I'm upstairs, you come up.

examples.chinese: 你在楼上等我一下。
examples.pinyin: nǐ zài lóushàng děng wǒ yīxià 。
examples.translation: You are waiting for me upstairs.

examples.chinese: 出来玩吧，我们在酒吧等你。
examples.pinyin: chūlái wán ba ，wǒmen zài jǐuba děng nǐ 。
examples.translation: Come out to play, we are waiting for you at the bar.

examples.chinese: 我妈不让我出去。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mā bù ràng wǒ chūqù 。
examples.translation: My mom won't let me go out.

examples.chinese: 这是我家，进来吧，随便坐。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒjiā ，jìnlái ba ，súibiàn zuò 。
examples.translation: This is my home. Come in and sit casually.

title: Potential complement
structure: Subj. + Verb + 得 / 不 + Complement

examples.chinese: 你没戴眼镜，看得清楚吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ méi dài yǎnjìng ，kàn dé qīngchǔ ma ？
examples.translation: You do n’t wear glasses, can you see clearly?

examples.chinese: 他这么粗心，做得好吗？
examples.pinyin: tā zhèyāo cūxīn ，zuò dé hǎo ma ？
examples.translation: He is so careless, is he doing well?

examples.pinyin: nǐ zhèyāo cōngmíng ，kěndìng xué dé hùi 。
examples.translation: If you are so smart, you will definitely learn it.

examples.chinese: 早上五点出发，孩子们起得来吗？
examples.pinyin: zǎoshàng wǔdiǎn chūfā ，háizǐmen qǐ dé lái ma ？
examples.translation: Will the children get up at five in the morning?

examples.pinyin: zhèyāo gāo de shān ，nǐ pá dé shàngqù ma ？
examples.translation: Can you climb such a high mountain?

examples.chinese: 你吃好了吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ chī hǎo le ma ？
examples.translation: Have you eaten

examples.chinese: 对不起，我记错了时间。
examples.pinyin: dùibùqǐ ，wǒ jì cuò le shíjiān 。
examples.translation: Sorry, I remembered the wrong time.

examples.chinese: 你来晚了，我们已经关门了。
examples.pinyin: nǐ lái wǎn le ，wǒmen yǐjīng guānmén le 。
examples.translation: You are late, we are already closed.

examples.chinese: 他玩坏了哥哥的玩具。
examples.pinyin: tā wán huài le gēgē de wánjù 。
examples.translation: He broke his brother's toy.

examples.chinese: 我没吃饱。
examples.pinyin: wǒ méi chī bǎo 。
examples.translation: I am not full.

title: Result complement -xiaqu
structure: Subj. + Verb （+ 不） + 下去 (+ 了)

examples.chinese: 说下去。
examples.pinyin: shuō xiàqù 。
examples.translation: Keep talking.

examples.chinese: 这本书你一定要认真地看下去。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū nǐ yīdìng yào rènzhēn dì kàn xiàqù 。
examples.translation: You must read this book carefully.

examples.chinese: 这样做很有意义，你应该做下去。
examples.pinyin: zhèyáng zuò hěn yǒu yìyì ，nǐ yìnggāi zuò xiàqù 。
examples.translation: It makes sense to do so, you should do it.

examples.chinese: 他走了，因为他没脸待下去了。
examples.pinyin: tā zǒu le ，yīnwèi tā méiliǎn dài xiàqù le 。
examples.translation: He was gone because he was faceless.

examples.chinese: 你不能这样生活下去了。
examples.pinyin: nǐ bùnéng zhèyáng shēnghuó xiàqù le 。
examples.translation: You can't live like this anymore.

title: Expressing as long as with zhiyao
titleVi: Expressing as long as with zhiyao
usedFor: Indicating conditions, Indicating cause and effect

examples.chinese: 只要你真的喜欢，我就给你买。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào nǐ zhēnde xǐhuān， wǒ jìu gěi nǐ mǎi 。
examples.translation: As long as you really like it, I will buy it for you.

examples.pinyin: zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì xuéxí， jìu hùi yǒu jìnbù 。
examples.translation: As long as you study hard, there will be progress.

examples.chinese: 只要有你在，我就放心了。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào yǒu nǐ zài， wǒ jìu fàngxīn le 。
examples.translation: As long as you are there, I can rest assured.

examples.chinese: 只要下雨，她就会心情不好。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào xiàyǔ， tā jìu hùi xīnqíng bù hǎo 。
examples.translation: As long as it rains, she will be in a bad mood.

examples.chinese: 只要看到妈妈，宝宝就不哭了。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào kàndào māmā， bǎobǎo jìu bù kū le 。
examples.translation: As long as you see your mother, your baby will not cry.

examples.chinese: 我花了八千块才买到了旅游的东西。
examples.pinyin: wǒ huā le bā qiān kuài cái mǎi dào le lv̌yóu de dōngxī 。
examples.translation: It took me 8,000 yuan to buy things for travel.

examples.chinese: 小明花了很多心思才设计出了这张海报。

examples.translation: It took Xiao Ming a lot of thought to design this poster.

examples.chinese: 他用了很多年才原谅了他的妈妈。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng le hěn duō nián cái yuánliàng le tāde māmā 。
examples.translation: It took him many years to forgive his mother.

examples.chinese: 那本书我看了两遍才看懂。
examples.pinyin: nà běn shū wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn cái kàn dǒng 。
examples.translation: I read that book twice before I understood it.

examples.chinese: 我去了三次北京才见到了那个客户。
examples.pinyin: wǒ qù le sān cì běijīng cái jiàn dào le nàgè kèhù 。
examples.translation: I went to Beijing three times before I saw the customer.

title: Expressing only if with zhiyou
structure: 只有 + Essential Condition + 才 + Desired Outcome
usedFor: Indicating conditions, Indicating cause and effect

examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu nǔlì cái néng zuò hǎo gōngzuò 。
examples.translation: Only work hard to do a good job.

examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu duō chīfàn cái néng chánggāo 。
examples.translation: Only by eating more can you grow taller.

examples.chinese: 只有多说，你的中文才会提高。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu duō shuō，nǐdezhōngwén cái hùi tígāo 。
examples.translation: Only by speaking more will your Chinese improve.

examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu dàjiā yīqǐ zuò cái néng chénggōng 。
examples.translation: Only if you do it together can you succeed.

examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu xiě wán nǐde zuòyè cái néng kàn diànshì 。
examples.translation: Only after finishing your homework can you watch TV.

structure: 有的 + (Subj.) + Predicate， 有的 + (Subj.) + Predicate

examples.pinyin: wàiguórén yǒude hěn yǒuqián， yǒude méiqián 。
examples.translation: Some foreigners are rich and some have no money.

examples.translation: He wrote a lot of books, some sold well and some did not.

examples.pinyin: zhōngguócài yǒude hǎochī，yǒude bù hǎochī 。

examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn de yīfú yǒude gùi ， yǒude biànyí 。
examples.translation: Some clothes in this shop are expensive and some are cheap.

examples.pinyin: tā yī jù zhōngwén dū bù hùi shuō 。
examples.translation: He can't speak a sentence of Chinese.

examples.translation: Why is there no one here?

examples.chinese: 我一口都没吃。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yī kǒu dū méi chī 。
examples.translation: I didn't eat a bite.

examples.chinese: 来上海以前，他一个外国朋友都没有。

examples.translation: Before coming to Shanghai, he had no foreign friends.

title: Expressing the more... the more... with yue… yue…
titleVi: Expressing the more... the more... with yue… yue…

examples.translation: The more we think, the more angry we are.

examples.translation: She put my mobile phone in her bag.

examples.translation: The hot dog was eaten.

examples.chinese: 他被打了。
examples.pinyin: tā bèi dǎ le 。
examples.translation: He was beaten.

examples.chinese: 你被公司炒鱿鱼了？

examples.translation: Are you fired by the company?

examples.chinese: 我的手机被偷了。

examples.chinese: 桌子上放着一本书。

examples.translation: There is a book on the table.

examples.pinyin: dàtīng lǐ zhàn zháo yīxiē jǐngchá 。
examples.translation: There are some policemen standing in the hall.

examples.pinyin: jiàoshì lǐ zuò zháo liǎng bǎi duō gè xuéshēng 。
examples.translation: More than two hundred students sat in the classroom.

examples.translation: There are many old things piled in the basement.

examples.chinese: 楼下停着几辆车。
examples.pinyin: lóuxià tíng zháo jī liàng chē 。
examples.translation: There are a few cars parked downstairs.

title: Expressing as one likes with jiu
titleVi: Expressing as one likes with jiu

examples.translation: Eat if you want.

examples.translation: Just go if you want to go.

examples.translation: Buy it if you want, without asking me.

examples.chinese: 别害怕，想说就说。
examples.pinyin: bié hàipà ，xiǎng shuō jìu shuō 。
examples.translation: Don't be afraid, just talk.

examples.chinese: 想做就做，考虑那么多干吗？
examples.pinyin: xiǎng zuò jìu zuò ，kǎolv̀ nàyāo duō gānma ？
examples.translation: Just do it if you want, why do you think so much?

examples.chinese: 谁都可以进。

examples.translation: Dirty clothes are everywhere in his room.

examples.pinyin: wǒ tài lèi le，nǎér dū bù xiǎng qù 。

examples.translation: Your daughter is getting more and more beautiful.

examples.translation: You are getting better and better.

examples.chinese: 技术越来越发达了。
examples.pinyin: jìzhú yuèláiyuè fādá le 。
examples.translation: Technology is becoming more and more developed.

examples.chinese: 我在北京的胡同里走着走着就走丢了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài běijīng de hútóng lǐ zǒu zháo zǒu zháo jìu zǒudīu le 。
examples.translation: I walked and lost in the alleys of Beijing.

title: Expressing although with jinguan
structure: 尽管⋯⋯ ，但是 + Subj. + 还是⋯⋯

examples.chinese: 尽管老板最近不在，我们还是不能偷懒。
examples.pinyin: jǐnguǎn lǎobǎn zùijìn bùzài ，wǒmen huánshì bù néng tōulǎn 。
examples.translation: Despite the absence of the boss recently, we can't be lazy.

examples.chinese: 尽管我很生气，但是我没发脾气。
examples.pinyin: jǐnguǎn wǒ hěn shēngqì ，dànshì wǒ méi fāpíqì 。
examples.translation: Although I was angry, I didn't lose my temper.

examples.chinese: 尽管警察已经找到了一些证据，但是他们还是不能抓那个嫌疑人。
examples.pinyin: jǐnguǎn jǐngchá yǐjīng zhǎodào le yīxiē zhèngjù ，dànshì tāmen huánshì bùnéng zhuā nàgè xiányírén 。
examples.translation: Although the police had found some evidence, they could not arrest the suspect.

examples.chinese: 尽管他的书很有争议，但它还是出版了。
examples.pinyin: jǐnguǎn tā de shū hěn yǒu zhēngyì ，dàn tā huánshì chūbǎn le 。
examples.translation: Although his book is controversial, it is still published.

examples.chinese: 尽管困难很多，但是我们不能放弃。
examples.pinyin: jǐnguǎn kùnnán hěnduō ，dànshì wǒmen bùnéng fàngqì 。
examples.translation: Despite the difficulties, we cannot give up.

examples.chinese: 他不是很努力，成绩倒也不错。
examples.pinyin: tā bù shì hěn nǔlì ，chéngjī dǎo yě bùcuò 。
examples.translation: He didn't work very hard, and his grades were not bad.

examples.chinese: 已经是春天了，倒又冷起来了。
examples.pinyin: yǐjīng shì chūntiān le，dǎo yòu lěng qǐlái le 。
examples.translation: It was already spring and it was cold again.

examples.chinese: 不吃药，病倒慢慢好了。
examples.pinyin: bù chī yào ，bìng dǎo mànmàn hǎo le 。
examples.translation: Without medicine, he fell ill slowly.

examples.chinese: 英语不是他的母语，他说得倒挺地道的。
examples.pinyin: yīngyǔ bù shì tā de mǔyǔ ，tā shuō dé dǎo tǐng dìdào de 。
examples.translation: English is not his mother tongue, he speaks quite authentically.

examples.chinese: 这篇文章的内容倒不错，就是太长了。
examples.pinyin: zhè piān wénzhāng de nèiróng dǎo bùcuò ，jìushì tài cháng le 。
examples.translation: The content of this article is pretty good, it is too long.

examples.chinese: 我是你最好的朋友，你却没邀请我。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shì nǐ zùihǎo de péngyǒu ，nǐ què méi yāoqǐng wǒ 。
examples.translation: I am your best friend, but you did not invite me.

examples.chinese: 我是你最好的朋友，但是你却没邀请我。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shì nǐ zùihǎo de péngyǒu ，dànshì nǐ què méi yāoqǐng wǒ 。
examples.translation: I am your best friend, but you did not invite me.

examples.chinese: 他家很有钱，他却从来不炫耀。
examples.pinyin: tā jiā hěn yǒuqián ，tā què cónglái bù xuànyào 。
examples.translation: His family is rich, but he never shows off.

examples.chinese: 他家很有钱，但是他却从来不炫耀。
examples.pinyin: tā jiā hěn yǒuqián ，dànshì tā què cónglái bù xuànyào 。
examples.translation: His family is rich, but he never shows off.

examples.chinese: 他是老板，却没有人听他的。
examples.pinyin: tā shì lǎobǎn ，què méiyǒu rén tīng tā de 。
examples.translation: He is the boss, but no one listens to him.

examples.chinese: 由于温室效应的影响，全球的气候变得越来越反常了。
examples.pinyin: yóuyú wēnshìxiàoyìng de yǐngxiǎng，quánqíu de qìhòu biàndé yuè lái yuè fǎncháng le 。
examples.translation: Due to the influence of the greenhouse effect, the global climate has become more and more abnormal.

examples.chinese: 由于意见不一致，两位老板吵了起来。
examples.pinyin: yóuyú yìjiàn bùyīzhì，liǎngwèi lǎobǎn chǎoleqǐlái 。
examples.translation: The two bosses quarreled because of disagreement.

examples.chinese: 由于公司发展的需要，我们打算再招聘一些新的老师。
examples.pinyin: yóuyú gōngsī fāzhǎn de xūyào，wǒmen dǎsuàn zài zhāopìn yīxiē xīnde lǎoshī 。
examples.translation: Due to the development of the company, we plan to recruit some new teachers.

examples.chinese: 由于目标客户的变化，企业的营销策略需要做出一些调整。
examples.pinyin: yóuyú mùbiāokèhù de biànhuà，qǐyè de yíngxiāo cèlvè xūyào zuòchū yīxiē diàozhěng 。
examples.translation: Due to changes in target customers, the company's marketing strategy needs to be adjusted.

examples.chinese: 由于人口的快速增加，大城市的社会问题越来越严重。
examples.pinyin: yóuyúrénkǒu de kuàisù zēngjiā，dàchéngshì de shèhùiwèntí yuèláiyuè yánzhòng 。
examples.translation: Due to the rapid increase in population, the social problems in large cities are becoming more and more serious.

title: Expressing since with jiran
structure: 既然＋Fact, 那 / 就 / 那就＋Suggestion / Inference :: / :: 既然 + Fact, （那 +）rhetorical question

examples.chinese: 你既然不想说，那就别说了。
examples.pinyin: nǐ jìrán bù xiǎng shuō，nàjìu bié shuō le 。
examples.translation: Since you don't want to say it, don't say it.

examples.chinese: 既然你那么喜欢，那就买吧。
examples.pinyin: jìrán nǐ nàyāo xǐhuān，nàjìu mǎi ba 。
examples.translation: Since you like it so much, buy it.

examples.chinese: 她既然刚刚分手，那现在应该是单身吧。
examples.pinyin: tā jìrán gānggāng fēnshǒu，nà xiànzài yìnggāi shì dānshēn ba 。
examples.translation: Since she just broke up, she should be single now.

examples.chinese: 既然你们是好朋友，那他肯定会帮你吧。
examples.pinyin: jìrán nǐmen shì hǎo péngyǒu，nà tā kěndìng hùi bāng nǐ ba 。
examples.translation: Since you are good friends, he will definitely help you.

examples.chinese: 既然大家都不感兴趣，就换个话题吧。
examples.pinyin: jìrán dàjiā dū bù gǎn xīngqù，jìu huàn gè huàtí ba 。
examples.translation: Since everyone is not interested, just change the subject.

examples.chinese: 她在农村长大，因此很了解农民的生活。
examples.pinyin: tā zài nóngcūn chángdà， yīncǐ hěn lejiě nóngmín de shēnghuó 。
examples.translation: She grew up in the countryside, so she knows the farmer's life well.

examples.chinese: 工厂已经停产很久了，因此无法给工人发工资。
examples.pinyin: gōngchǎng yǐjīng tíngchǎn hěn jǐu le， yīncǐ wúfǎ gěi gōngrén fā gōngzī 。
examples.translation: The factory has been shut down for a long time, so it is impossible to pay workers.

examples.chinese: 韩寒的文笔好，因此他写的小说很受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: hánhán de wénbǐ hǎo， yīncǐ tā xiě de xiǎoshuō hěn shòu huānyíng 。
examples.translation: Han Han's writing is good, so his novels are very popular.

title: Advanced uses of direction complement -qilai
structure: Verb + 起来 :: / :: Subj. + 把 + Obj. + Verb + 起来

examples.chinese: 13和15加起来是多少？
examples.pinyin: 13 hé 15 jiā qǐlái shì duōshǎo ？
examples.translation: What is the sum of 13 and 15?

examples.chinese: 他把衣服都收起来了。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ yīfú dū shōu qǐlái le 。
examples.translation: He put away his clothes.

examples.chinese: 我老婆把钱都存起来了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ lǎopó bǎ qián dū cún qǐlái le 。
examples.translation: My wife saved all the money.

examples.chinese: 把你的玩具都收起来。
examples.pinyin: bǎ nǐ de wánjù dū shōu qǐlái 。
examples.translation: Put away all your toys.

examples.chinese: 你为什么要把我的手机藏起来？
examples.pinyin: nǐ wèishíyāo yào bǎ wǒ de shǒujī cáng qǐlái ？
examples.translation: Why are you hiding my phone?

title: Direction complement
usedFor: Describing actions, Expressing movement, Describing places

examples.chinese: 我在楼上，你上来。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài lóushàng ，nǐ shànglái 。
examples.translation: I'm upstairs, you come up.

examples.chinese: 你在楼上等我一下。
examples.pinyin: nǐ zài lóushàng děng wǒ yīxià 。
examples.translation: You are waiting for me upstairs.

examples.chinese: 出来玩吧，我们在酒吧等你。
examples.pinyin: chūlái wán ba ，wǒmen zài jǐuba děng nǐ 。
examples.translation: Come out to play, we are waiting for you at the bar.

examples.chinese: 我妈不让我出去。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mā bù ràng wǒ chūqù 。
examples.translation: My mom won't let me go out.

examples.chinese: 这是我家，进来吧，随便坐。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒjiā ，jìnlái ba ，súibiàn zuò 。
examples.translation: This is my home. Come in and sit casually.

title: Direction complement -qilai
usedFor: Describing actions, Expressing movement, Expressing result

examples.chinese: 请大家站起来。
examples.pinyin: qǐng dàjiā zhàn qǐlái 。
examples.translation: Please stand up.

examples.chinese: 捡起来。
examples.pinyin: jiǎn qǐlái 。
examples.translation: pick it up.

examples.chinese: 头抬起来。
examples.pinyin: tóu tái qǐlái 。
examples.translation: Head up.

examples.chinese: 别动！把手举起来。
examples.pinyin: biédòng ！bǎ shǒu jǔ qǐlái 。
examples.translation: do not move! Raise your hand.

examples.chinese: 小鸟飞起来了。
examples.pinyin: xiǎoniǎo fēi qǐlái le 。
examples.translation: The bird flew up.

title: Potential complement
structure: Subj. + Verb + 不 / 得 + Complement

examples.chinese: 你没戴眼镜，看得清楚吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ méi dài yǎnjìng ，kàn dé qīngchǔ ma ？
examples.translation: You do n’t wear glasses, can you see clearly?

examples.chinese: 他这么粗心，做得好吗？
examples.pinyin: tā zhèyāo cūxīn ，zuò dé hǎo ma ？
examples.translation: He is so careless, is he doing well?

examples.chinese: 你这么聪明，肯定学得会。
examples.pinyin: nǐ zhèyāo cōngmíng ，kěndìng xué dé hùi 。
examples.translation: If you are so smart, you will definitely learn it.

examples.chinese: 早上五点出发，孩子们起得来吗？
examples.pinyin: zǎoshàng wǔdiǎn chūfā ，háizǐmen qǐ dé lái ma ？
examples.translation: Will the children get up at five in the morning?

examples.chinese: 这么高的山，你爬得上去吗？
examples.pinyin: zhèyāo gāo de shān ，nǐ pá dé shàngqù ma ？
examples.translation: Can you climb such a high mountain?

title: Expressing as long as with zhiyao
titleVi: Expressing as long as with zhiyao
usedFor: Indicating conditions, Indicating cause and effect

examples.chinese: 只要你真的喜欢，我就给你买。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào nǐ zhēnde xǐhuān， wǒ jìu gěi nǐ mǎi 。
examples.translation: As long as you really like it, I will buy it for you.

examples.chinese: 只要你努力学习，就会有进步。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì xuéxí， jìu hùi yǒu jìnbù 。
examples.translation: As long as you study hard, there will be progress.

examples.chinese: 只要有你在，我就放心了。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào yǒu nǐ zài， wǒ jìu fàngxīn le 。
examples.translation: As long as you are there, I can rest assured.

examples.chinese: 只要下雨，她就会心情不好。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào xiàyǔ， tā jìu hùi xīnqíng bù hǎo 。
examples.translation: As long as it rains, she will be in a bad mood.

examples.chinese: 只要看到妈妈，宝宝就不哭了。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào kàndào māmā， bǎobǎo jìu bù kū le 。
examples.translation: As long as you see your mother, your baby will not cry.

examples.chinese: 我不去，除非你也去。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bù qù ，chúfēi nǐ yě qù 。
examples.translation: I will not go unless you go too.

examples.chinese: 你不能进，除非你有预约。
examples.pinyin: nǐ bùnéng jìn ，chúfēi nǐ yǒu yùyuē 。
examples.translation: You cannot enter unless you have an appointment.

examples.chinese: 我不说，除非你答应我你不会生气。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bù shuō ，chúfēi nǐ dáyìng wǒ nǐ bùhùi shēngqì 。
examples.translation: I will not say that unless you promise me you will not be angry.

examples.chinese: 你不会这么快升职，除非你表现很好。
examples.pinyin: nǐ bù hùi zhèyāo kuài shēngzhí ，chúfēi nǐ biǎoxiàn hěn hǎo 。
examples.translation: You won't get promoted so quickly unless you perform well.

examples.chinese: 我们公司一般不允许员工请假，除非理由很充分。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen gōngsī yībān bù yǔnxǔ yuángōng qǐngjiǎ ，chúfēi lǐyóu hěn chōngfēn 。
examples.translation: Our company generally does not allow employees to take leave, unless the reasons are good.

examples.chinese: 即使他没钱，我也要嫁给他。
examples.pinyin: jíshǐ tā méiqián ，wǒ yě yào jiàgěi tā 。
examples.translation: Even if he has no money, I will marry him.

examples.chinese: 即使你很有钱，也买不到幸福。
examples.pinyin: jíshǐ nǐ hěn yǒuqián ，yě mǎibùdào xìngfú 。
examples.translation: Even if you are rich, you can't buy happiness.

examples.chinese: 即使你没胃口，也要吃一点。
examples.pinyin: jíshǐ nǐ méiwèikǒu ，yě yào chī yīdiǎn 。
examples.translation: Even if you have no appetite, eat a little.

examples.chinese: 即使你对这门课不太感兴趣，也要学。
examples.pinyin: jíshǐ nǐ dùi zhè mén kè bùtài gǎnxīngqù ，yě yào xué 。
examples.translation: Even if you are not very interested in this course, you still have to learn it.

examples.chinese: 即使她整容，我也能认出她。
examples.pinyin: jíshǐ tā zhěngróng ，wǒ yě néng rènchū tā 。
examples.translation: Even if she had a plastic surgery, I could recognize her.

title: Expressing if… then… with yaoshi
usedFor: Indicating conditions, Indicating cause and effect, Expressing possibility

examples.chinese: 你要是真想我，就给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: nǐ yàoshì zhēn xiǎng wǒ ，jìu gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà 。
examples.translation: If you really miss me, call me.

examples.chinese: 要是我妈知道这件事，我就死定了!
examples.pinyin: yàoshì wǒmā zhīdào zhè jiàn shì ，wǒ jìu sǐ dìngle !
examples.translation: If my mother knew about it, I would be dead!

examples.chinese: 要是老板不同意，我们就不能跟客户签合同。
examples.pinyin: yàoshì lǎobǎn bù tóngyì，wǒmen jìu bù néng gēn kèhù qiān hétóng 。
examples.translation: If the boss doesn't agree, we can't sign a contract with the customer.

examples.chinese: 你要再说，我真生气了。
examples.pinyin: nǐ yào zài shuō ，wǒ zhēn shēngqì le 。
examples.translation: You have to say it again, I am really angry.

examples.chinese: 他要不听，我也没办法。
examples.pinyin: tā yào bù tīng ，wǒ yě méi bànfǎ 。
examples.translation: If he doesn't listen, I can't help it.

title: Expressing no matter with buguan
usedFor: Indicating conditions, Expressing attitude, Expressing determination

examples.chinese: 不管你穿什么都好看。
examples.pinyin: bùguǎn nǐ chuān shíyāo dū hǎokàn 。
examples.translation: It looks good no matter what you wear.

examples.chinese: 不管怎么样，我们都要好好准备。
examples.pinyin: bùguǎn zěnyāoyáng ，wǒmen dū yào hǎohǎo zhǔnbèi 。
examples.translation: Either way, we must be well prepared.

examples.chinese: 不管你在哪儿工作，都要交税。
examples.pinyin: bùguǎn nǐ zài nǎér gōngzuò ，dū yào jiāoshùi 。
examples.translation: No matter where you work, you have to pay taxes.

examples.chinese: 不管别人怎么想，你都要坚持。
examples.pinyin: bùguǎn biérén zěnyāo xiǎng ，nǐ dū yào jiānchí 。
examples.translation: No matter what other people think, you must insist.

examples.chinese: 不管你是什么时候买的，我们都可以免费修。
examples.pinyin: bùguǎn nǐ shì shíyāo shíhòu mǎi de ，wǒmen dū kěyǐ miǎnfèi xīu 。
examples.translation: No matter when you bought it, we can repair it for free.

title: Expressing no matter with wulun
structure: 无论 + Circumstances + 都 / 也 + Inevitable Result
usedFor: Indicating conditions, Expressing attitude, Expressing determination

examples.chinese: 无论怎么样，他都会放弃，别高估他。
examples.pinyin: wúlùn zěnyāoyáng，tā dū hùi fàngqì，bié gāogū tā 。
examples.translation: No matter what, he will give up, don't overestimate him.

examples.chinese: 无论多么成功，他总觉得自己不够好。
examples.pinyin: wúlùn duōyāo chénggōng，tā zǒng juédé zìjǐ bùgòu hǎo 。
examples.translation: No matter how successful, he always feels that he is not good enough.

examples.chinese: 无论你到哪儿我都会跟着你。
examples.pinyin: wúlùn nǐ dào nǎér wǒ dū hùi gēnzháo nǐ 。
examples.translation: I will follow you wherever you go.

examples.chinese: 无论你说还是不说，结果都一样。
examples.pinyin: wúlùn nǐ shuō huánshì bù shuō，jiéguǒ dū yīyáng 。
examples.translation: Whether you say it or not, the result is the same.

examples.chinese: 你买了她所有的书？
examples.pinyin: nǐ mǎi le tā suǒyǒu de shū ？
examples.translation: Did you buy all her books?

examples.chinese: 我喜欢所有我妈妈做的菜。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuān suǒyǒu wǒ māmā zuò de cài 。
examples.translation: I like all the dishes my mother makes.

examples.chinese: 他记得所有朋友的生日。
examples.pinyin: tā jìdé suǒyǒu péngyǒu de shēngrì 。
examples.translation: He remembers the birthdays of all his friends.

examples.chinese: 我的孩子看过所有的迪斯尼动画片。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de háizǐ kàn guò suǒyǒu de dísīní dònghuàpiàn 。
examples.translation: My child has seen all Disney cartoons.

examples.chinese: 所有人都走了吗？
examples.pinyin: suǒyǒu rén dū zǒu le ma ？
examples.translation: Has everyone gone?

title: Expressing one of with zhiyi
structure: Subj. + 是 + [Noun Phrase] + 之一 :: / :: [Noun Phrase] + 之一 + 是 ⋯⋯

examples.chinese: 她是我最好的朋友之一。
examples.pinyin: tā shì wǒ zùi hǎo de péngyǒu zhī yī 。
examples.translation: She is one of my best friends.

examples.chinese: Frozen是我最喜欢的迪斯尼电影之一。
examples.pinyin: Frozen shì wǒ zùi xǐhuān de dísīní diànyǐng zhī yī 。
examples.translation: Frozen is one of my favorite Disney movies.

examples.chinese: 纽约是世界上最国际化的城市之一。
examples.pinyin: nǐuyuē shì shìjiè shàng zùi guójìhuà de chéngshì zhī yī 。
examples.translation: New York is one of the most international cities in the world.

examples.chinese: 他是这个公司的创始人之一。
examples.pinyin: tā shì zhègè gōngsī de chuàngshǐrén zhī yī 。
examples.translation: He is one of the founders of this company.

examples.chinese: 成龙是最有名的中国明星之一。

titleVi: Expressing as much as possible with jinliang

examples.pinyin: wǒ hùi jǐnliàng xiǎng bànfǎ bāng nǐ de 。
examples.translation: I will try my best to help you.

examples.chinese: 你看书吧，我尽量不打扰你。
examples.pinyin: nǐ kàn shū ba，wǒ jǐnliàng bù dǎrǎo nǐ 。
examples.translation: You read a book, I try not to disturb you.

examples.chinese: 父母应该尽量多陪陪孩子。
examples.pinyin: fùmǔ yìnggāi jǐnliàng duō péi péi háizǐ 。
examples.translation: Parents should accompany their children as much as possible.

examples.chinese: 你是哥哥，要尽量照顾好妹妹。
examples.pinyin: nǐ shì gēgē，yào jǐnliàng zhàogù hǎo mèimèi 。
examples.translation: You are an elder brother, you should take good care of your sister as much as possible.

examples.chinese: 我们要尽量避免问这种问题，有的客户会感觉很不舒服。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yào jǐnliàng bìmiǎn wèn zhè zhǒng wèntí，yǒude kèhù hùi gǎnjué hěnbùshūfú 。
examples.translation: We should try to avoid asking this kind of question, some customers will feel very uncomfortable.

title: Expressing difficulty with hao (bu) rongyi
structure: Subj. + 好容易 / 好不容易 + 才 + Verb，[Result Sentence]

examples.chinese: 我们好不容易才做完这个项目，结果合同取消了。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen hǎobùróngyì cái zuòwán zhè gè xiàngmù，jiéguǒ hétóng qǔxiāo le 。
examples.translation: We finally finished the project and the contract was cancelled.

examples.chinese: 我好不容易才到市中心，却发现没带手机，只好回去拿。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hǎobùróngyì cái dào shìzhōngxīn， què fāxiàn méi dài shǒujī，zhǐhǎo húiqù ná 。
examples.translation: I finally got to the city center, but found that I didn't bring my cell phone with me, so I had to go back and get it.

examples.chinese: 金融危机之后他好不容易才找到工作，现在又辞职了。
examples.pinyin: jīnróng wēijī zhīhòu tā hǎobùróngyì cái zhǎodào gōngzuò，xiànzài yòu cízhí le 。
examples.translation: After the financial crisis, he finally found a job, and now he resigned.

examples.chinese: 我好不容易才打通了银行的服务热线。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hǎobùróngyì cái dǎtōng le yínxíng de fúwù rèxiàn 。
examples.translation: I finally got through the bank's service hotline.

examples.chinese: 他们好不容易才爬到了山顶，结果下起了大雨。
examples.pinyin: tāmen hǎobùróngyì cái pá dào le shāndǐng，jiéguǒ xiàqǐ le dàyǔ 。
examples.translation: They finally climbed to the top of the mountain and it rained heavily.

examples.chinese: 互相帮助
examples.pinyin: hùxiāng bāngzhù
examples.translation: Help each other

examples.chinese: 互相了解
examples.pinyin: hùxiāng lejiě
examples.translation: know each other

examples.chinese: 互相伤害
examples.pinyin: hùxiāng shānghài
examples.translation: Hurt each other

examples.chinese: 互相尊重
examples.pinyin: hùxiāng zūnzhòng
examples.translation: mutual respect

examples.chinese: 互相支持
examples.pinyin: hùxiāng zhīchí
examples.translation: Support each other

examples.chinese: 大家有话尽管说。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā yǒu huà jǐnguǎn shuō 。
examples.translation: Everyone has something to say.

examples.chinese: 有什么问题尽管问。
examples.pinyin: yǒu shíyāo wèntí jǐnguǎn wèn 。
examples.translation: Just ask any questions.

examples.chinese: 有什么事尽管找我。
examples.pinyin: yǒu shíyāo shì jǐnguǎn zhǎo wǒ 。
examples.translation: Please come to me for anything.

examples.chinese: 这些饮料是免费的，尽管喝。
examples.pinyin: zhèxiē yǐnliào shì miǎnfèi de ， jǐnguǎn hē 。
examples.translation: These drinks are free, despite drinking.

examples.chinese: 想吃什么尽管点，我请客。
examples.pinyin: xiǎng chī shíyāo jǐnguǎn diǎn ， wǒ qǐngkè 。
examples.translation: I want to eat whatever I want.

examples.chinese: 我们都是打工的，不得不服从公司的安排。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen dū shì dǎgōngde ， bùdébù fúcóng gōngsī de ānpái 。
examples.translation: We are all part-time workers and have to obey the company's arrangements.

examples.chinese: 你真的太厉害了，我不得不承认。
examples.pinyin: nǐ zhēnde tài lìhài le ， wǒ bùdébù chéngrèn 。
examples.translation: You are really amazing, I have to admit.

examples.chinese: 电梯又坏了，我们不得不爬楼梯。
examples.pinyin: diàntī yòu huàile ， wǒmen bùdébù pálóutī 。
examples.translation: The elevator broke down again and we had to climb the stairs.

examples.chinese: 你真会说话，这一点我们不得不佩服。
examples.pinyin: nǐ zhēn hùi shuōhuà ，zhèyīdiǎn wǒmen bùdébù pèifú 。
examples.translation: You really talk, we have to admire this.

examples.chinese: 不好意思，时间有限，我不得不打断你。
examples.pinyin: bùhǎoyìsī ，shíjiān yǒuxiàn ，wǒ bùdébù dǎduàn nǐ 。
examples.translation: Sorry, time is limited, I have to interrupt you.

title: Expressing just do it with gancui
titleVi: Expressing just do it with gancui

examples.chinese: 家里什么都没有，干脆出去吃吧。
examples.pinyin: jiālǐshíyāodūméiyǒu，gāncùichūqùchība 。
examples.translation: There is nothing at home, just go out and eat.

examples.chinese: 既然学不好，干脆别学了。
examples.pinyin: jìránxuébùhǎo，gāncùibiéxuéle 。
examples.translation: Since you haven't learned well, just stop learning.

examples.chinese: 这台破电脑又坏了，干脆别修了，买台新的吧。
examples.pinyin: zhètáipòdiànnǎoyòuhuàile，gāncùibiéxīule，mǎitáixīndeba 。
examples.translation: This broken computer is broken again. Don't fix it, just buy a new one.

examples.chinese: 苹果很贵，我干脆没买，只买了点香蕉。
examples.pinyin: píngguǒhěngùi，wǒgāncùiméimǎi，zhǐmǎilediǎnxiāngjiāo 。
examples.translation: Apples are very expensive. I didn't buy them at all. I just bought some bananas.

title: Expressing nearly with jihu
structure: 几乎 + Subj. + 都 + Verb / Adj.

examples.chinese: 几乎每个人都有手机。
examples.pinyin: jīhū měi gè rén dū yǒu shǒujī 。
examples.translation: Almost everyone has a mobile phone.

examples.chinese: 在我们公司，几乎每个人都会说英文。
examples.pinyin: zài wǒmen gōngsī，jīhū měi gè rén dū hùi shuō yīngwén 。
examples.translation: In our company, almost everyone speaks English.

examples.chinese: 在中国，几乎所有老外都会说“你好”。
examples.pinyin: zài zhōngguó，jīhū suǒyǒu lǎowài dū hùi shuō “nǐhǎo” 。
examples.translation: In China, almost all foreigners will say hello.

examples.chinese: 几乎所有人都相信他。
examples.pinyin: jīhū suǒyǒu rén dū xiāngxìn tā 。
examples.translation: Almost everyone believed him.

examples.chinese: 几乎全世界的观众都喜欢这部电影。
examples.pinyin: jīhū quán shìjiè de guānzhòng dū xǐhuān zhè bù diànyǐng 。
examples.translation: Almost all audiences around the world love this movie.

title: Expressing never again with zai ye bu
titleVi: Expressing never again with zai ye bu
structure: Subj. + 再也 + 不 + Verb-Obj. + 了
usedFor: Referring to the future, Expressing time and date

examples.chinese: 我再也不想看到你了！
examples.pinyin: wǒ zàiyěbù xiǎng kàndào nǐ le ！
examples.translation: I don't want to see you anymore!

examples.chinese: 我再也不想跟你说话了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zàiyěbù xiǎng gēn nǐ shuōhuà le 。
examples.translation: I don't want to talk to you anymore.

examples.chinese: 我们再也不会相信你了！
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zàiyěbù hùi xiāngxìn nǐ le ！
examples.translation: We will never trust you again!

examples.chinese: 医生说她再也不能跳舞了。
examples.pinyin: yìshēng shuō tāzàiyěbù néng tiàowǔ le 。
examples.translation: The doctor said she could no longer dance.

examples.chinese: 我再也不要离开你了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zàiyěbù yào líkāi nǐ le 。
examples.translation: I will never leave you again.

title: Expressing once with cengjing
structure: Subj. + 曾经 + Verb + 过 (+ Obj.)
usedFor: Referring to the past, Expressing time and date

examples.chinese: 我们曾经一起去过。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen céngjīng yīqǐ qù guò 。
examples.translation: We have been there together.

examples.chinese: 他说他曾经做过很多傻事。
examples.pinyin: tā shuō tā céngjīng zuò guò hěnduō shǎshì 。
examples.translation: He said he had done many stupid things.

examples.chinese: 我曾经喜欢过你。
examples.pinyin: wǒ céngjīng xǐhuān guò nǐ 。
examples.translation: I used to like you.

examples.chinese: 她曾经想当演员，后来成了全职太太。
examples.pinyin: tā céngjīng xiǎng dāng yǎnyuán ，hòulái chéng le quánzhítàitài 。
examples.translation: She once wanted to be an actor, but later became a full-time wife.

examples.chinese: 为了找亲生父母，她曾经花了很多钱。
examples.pinyin: wèile zhǎo qīnshēng fùmǔ ，tā céngjīng huā le hěnduōqián 。
examples.translation: In order to find her biological parents, she used to spend a lot of money.

title: Expressing over and over again with zaisan
titleVi: Expressing over and over again with zaisan

examples.chinese: 老师再三强调这次考试对我们很重要。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī zàisān qiángdiào zhè cì kǎoshì dùi wǒmen hěn zhòngyào 。
examples.translation: The teacher repeatedly emphasized that this exam is very important to us.

examples.translation: The Chinese government has repeatedly warned the United States not to interfere in China ’s internal affairs.

examples.chinese: 她再三犹豫之后，选择了放弃比赛。

examples.chinese: 我们再三考虑过后，决定满足你的这个要求。

examples.chinese: 我再三提醒你出国旅游一定要小心你的钱包。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zàisān tíxǐng nǐ chūguó lv̌yóu yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn nǐ de qiánbāo 。

examples.chinese: 他简直是个魔鬼！
examples.pinyin: tā jiǎnzhí shì gè mógǔi ！
examples.translation: He is simply a devil!

examples.chinese: 他唱歌简直难听死了！
examples.pinyin: tā chànggē jiǎnzhí nántīng sǐle ！
examples.translation: He sings so ugly!

examples.chinese: 你男朋友简直太帅了！
examples.pinyin: nǐ nán péngyǒu jiǎnzhí tài shuài le ！
examples.translation: Your boyfriend is so handsome!

examples.chinese: 我简直不明白他为什么这么傻！
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiǎnzhí bù míngbái tā wèishíyāo zhèyāo shǎ ！
examples.translation: I can't understand why he is so stupid!

examples.chinese: 我简直不知道怎么教这样的学生！
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiǎnzhí bù zhīdào zěnyāo jiào zhèyáng de xuéshēng ！
examples.translation: I just don't know how to teach such students!

title: Expressing since the beginning with yixiang
titleVi: Expressing since the beginning with yixiang

examples.pinyin: wǒ qù de shíhòu tā bù zài jiā， suǒyǐ wǒ bái pǎo le yī tàng 。

examples.chinese: 不好意思，让你白忙了一个早上，我们老板今天来不了了。
examples.pinyin: bùhǎoyìsī， ràng nǐ bái máng le yī gè zǎoshàng，wǒmen lǎobǎn jīntiān lái bùle le 。

title: Expressing while you're at it with shunbian
titleVi: Expressing while you're at it with shunbian

examples.chinese: 你去买早饭的时候顺便帮我带杯咖啡吧。

examples.chinese: 我下周去北京出差，顺便去看一个朋友。

examples.pinyin: wǒ chūmén de shíhòu dū hùi shùnbiàn rēng lājí 。

title: The opposite of chabuduo is cha hen duo
titleVi: The opposite of chabuduo is cha hen duo

title: Basic sentences: 是 / 有 / 很
titleVi: Basic sentences: 是 / 有 / 很
structure: S + 是/有 + O　|　S + 很 + Adj
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Chinese verbs never change form — no conjugation, ever. 是 links two nouns (A is B). 有 means 'to have' or 'there is'. Adjectives do NOT use 是; they connect with 很, which here is just a neutral linker, not 'very'. Negate 是 and adjectives with 不, but 有 always negates with 没.
tip: Never say 我是忙 — adjectives refuse 是. Say 我很忙.

examples.chinese: 我是学生。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shì xuéshēng.
examples.translation: I am a student.

examples.pinyin: tā yǒu yí ge dìdi.

examples.pinyin: jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
examples.translation: The weather is nice today.

examples.chinese: 我没有时间。
examples.pinyin: wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān.
examples.translation: I don't have time.

quiz.question: Pick the correct sentence for 'She is busy.'
quiz.explanation: Adjectives link with 很, not 是.

quiz.question: How do you negate 有?
quiz.explanation: 有 is the one verb that negates with 没, never 不.

title: Questions: 吗 / 呢 / 吧 + question words
titleVi: Questions: 吗 / 呢 / 吧 + question words
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 吗 turns any statement into a yes/no question. 呢 bounces a question back ('and you?') or asks where something is. 吧 expects agreement ('right?') or makes a soft suggestion. Question words (谁 who, 什么 what, 哪儿 where, 几/多少 how many, 怎么 how, 为什么 why) sit exactly where the answer would sit — word order does not change.
tip: Never combine a question word with 吗: 你喝什么吗？ is wrong.

title: Measure words 量词
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Every counted noun needs a measure word: 一个人, not 一人. 个 is the universal fallback, but the test loves specific ones: 本 (books), 杯 (cups of), 件 (clothes/matters), 条 (long thin things), 张 (flat things), 只 (animals), 块 (money/pieces), 辆 (vehicles), 双 (pairs), 位 (people, polite), 层 (floors), 种 (kinds).
tip: Before a measure word, 'two' is 两, never 二: 两个人 ✓, 二个人 ✗.

examples.chinese: 我买了三本书。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le sān běn shū.
examples.translation: I bought three books.

examples.chinese: 他喝了两杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: tā hē le liǎng bēi kāfēi.
examples.translation: He drank two cups of coffee.

examples.chinese: 这件衬衫有点儿大。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn chènshān yǒudiǎnr dà.
examples.translation: This shirt is a bit big.

examples.chinese: 我家有两只猫。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng zhī māo.
examples.translation: My family has two cats.

quiz.question: 三___裤子 (trousers)
quiz.explanation: 条 for long, thin things: 裤子, 河, 鱼.

quiz.question: 一___出租车
quiz.explanation: 辆 counts vehicles.

title: Time words & word order
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Time sits before the verb (or before the subject for emphasis) — never at the end like English. Place (在…) also comes before the verb. Order inside time: big → small (year → month → day → hour).
tip: 'He works in Beijing' = 他在北京工作 — the 在-phrase goes BEFORE the verb.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七点起床。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.translation: I get up at 7 every morning.

examples.chinese: 他明天去北京。
examples.pinyin: tā míngtiān qù Běijīng.
examples.translation: He goes to Beijing tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我们星期六在家看电视。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen xīngqīliù zài jiā kàn diànshì.
examples.translation: We watch TV at home on Saturday.

quiz.question: Correct order for 'I study Chinese at school every day':
options: 我学习汉语每天在学校。
我每天在学校学习汉语。
每天我学习在学校汉语。
quiz.explanation: S + time + place + V + O.

quiz.question: Which is correct?
quiz.explanation: Time before the verb (or before the subject).

title: 了 / 过 / 正在
structure: V + 了 (done)　|　V + 过 (ever)　|　正在 + V (right now)
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 了 after the verb = action completed; 了 at sentence end = situation changed (天冷了 it's gotten cold). 过 = past experience ('have ever done'). 正在…(呢) = happening right now. Negation: 没(有) + V — and then 了 disappears: 我没吃饭 ✓, 我没吃了饭 ✗.
tip: 过 cares about experience, 了 cares about completion: 我去了北京 (I went) vs 我去过北京 (I've been there before).

examples.chinese: 我吃了三个苹果。
examples.pinyin: wǒ chī le sān ge píngguǒ.
examples.translation: I ate three apples.

examples.chinese: 他去过中国两次。
examples.pinyin: tā qùguo Zhōngguó liǎng cì.
examples.translation: He has been to China twice.

examples.chinese: 我正在做作业呢。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhèngzài zuò zuòyè ne.
examples.translation: I'm doing homework right now.

examples.chinese: 天气冷了。
examples.pinyin: tiānqì lěng le.
examples.translation: It's gotten cold.

quiz.question: 'Have you ever eaten Beijing roast duck?' uses…
quiz.explanation: Experience = V + 过.

quiz.question: Negate 我吃了饭:
quiz.explanation: 没 negates completion and 了 must drop.

title: Modal verbs: 想 / 要 / 会 / 能 / 可以 / 别
titleVi: Modal verbs: 想 / 要 / 会 / 能 / 可以 / 别
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 想 = want (wish), 要 = want/going to (stronger), 会 = can (learned skill) or 'will likely', 能 = can (ability/circumstance), 可以 = may (permission). 别 + V = don't (command). Negations: 不想, 不要, 不会, 不能.
tip: 会 = learned it (swim, speak Chinese). 能 = physically/situationally possible. 可以 = allowed.

examples.chinese: 我想去中国旅游。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó lǚyóu.
examples.translation: I want to travel to China.

examples.chinese: 我会说一点儿汉语。
examples.pinyin: wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎnr Hànyǔ.
examples.translation: I can speak a little Chinese.

examples.chinese: 图书馆里不能打电话。
examples.pinyin: túshūguǎn li bù néng dǎ diànhuà.
examples.translation: You can't make phone calls in the library.

examples.chinese: 别忘了带护照。
examples.pinyin: bié wàng le dài hùzhào.
examples.translation: Don't forget to bring your passport.

quiz.question: 'I CAN swim (I learned it)' = 我___游泳。
quiz.explanation: Learned skills take 会.

quiz.question: 'Don't drink coffee!' =
quiz.explanation: Commands use 别 + verb.

title: Places: 在 / 里 / 上 / 旁边 / 离
titleVi: Places: 在 / 里 / 上 / 旁边 / 离
structure: X 在 Place + 里/上/旁边…　|　A 离 B 很近/远
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 在 locates things: X 在 Y. Position words follow the place: 里 inside, 上 on, 下 under, 旁边 beside, 前面 in front, 后面 behind, 中间 middle. 离 measures distance between two points: A 离 B 很近/很远.
tip: Existence flips the order: Place + 有 + thing (桌子上有书) vs thing + 在 + place (书在桌子上).

examples.chinese: 银行在超市旁边。
examples.pinyin: yínháng zài chāoshì pángbiān.
examples.translation: The bank is next to the supermarket.

examples.chinese: 桌子上有一杯茶。
examples.pinyin: zhuōzi shang yǒu yì bēi chá.
examples.translation: There's a cup of tea on the table.

examples.chinese: 我家离公司很近。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiā lí gōngsī hěn jìn.
examples.translation: My home is close to the office.

quiz.question: 'The cat is under the chair' =
quiz.explanation: Thing + 在 + place + position word.

quiz.question: 机场___这儿很远。
quiz.explanation: Distance between two points = 离.

title: Comparing: 比 / 最 / 没有…那么
titleVi: Comparing: 比 / 最 / 没有…那么
structure: A 比 B + Adj　|　最 + Adj　|　A 没有 B (那么) Adj
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: A 比 B 高 = A is taller than B — the adjective stays bare (no 很!). Add degree after the adjective: 比我高一点儿 / 比我大三岁 / 比我更高. The negative comparison is A 没有 B (那么) Adj = A isn't as Adj as B. 最 = the most.
tip: 比-sentences never take 很: 他比我很高 ✗ → 他比我高 / 他比我更高 ✓.

examples.chinese: 今天比昨天冷。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng.
examples.translation: Today is colder than yesterday.

examples.chinese: 他比我大三岁。
examples.pinyin: tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.
examples.translation: He is three years older than me.

examples.chinese: 她是我们班最高的学生。
examples.pinyin: tā shì wǒmen bān zuì gāo de xuésheng.
examples.translation: She is the tallest student in our class.

examples.chinese: 我没有他那么忙。
examples.pinyin: wǒ méiyǒu tā nàme máng.
examples.translation: I'm not as busy as he is.

quiz.question: Which is correct?
quiz.explanation: No 很 inside a 比 comparison.

quiz.question: 'I'm not as tall as you' =
quiz.explanation: A 没有 B + Adj is the standard 'not as…as'.

title: Adverbs 都 / 也 / 还 + giving with 给
titleVi: Adverbs 都 / 也 / 还 + giving with 给
structure: S + 都/也/还 + V　|　给 + person + thing
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 都 (all), 也 (also), 还 (still / in addition) are adverbs — they must stand right before the verb, never before the subject like English 'also'. 给 hands something to someone: 给我一杯水, or marks the receiver: 给他打电话.
tip: 也 before 都 when both appear: 我们也都去 ✓.

examples.chinese: 我们都喜欢猫。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen dōu xǐhuan māo.
examples.translation: We all like cats.

examples.chinese: 她也想去。
examples.pinyin: tā yě xiǎng qù.
examples.translation: She wants to go too.

examples.chinese: 他还在睡觉。
examples.pinyin: tā hái zài shuìjiào.
examples.translation: He is still sleeping.

examples.chinese: 请给我一杯水。
examples.pinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ.
examples.translation: Please give me a glass of water.

quiz.question: 'I also like tea' =
quiz.explanation: 也 sits before the verb, after the subject.

quiz.question: 'Call me' =
quiz.explanation: Both orders are used; 给我打电话 is most standard.

title: Numbers, money, dates; 几 vs 多少; 两 vs 二
titleVi: Numbers, money, dates; 几 vs 多少; 两 vs 二
structure: …块（钱）　|　几 + MW (small) / 多少 (any size)
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Money: 块 (kuài) colloquial / 元 written, 角·毛 for tenths. Dates: 月 + 号. 几 asks about small numbers (under ~10) and always needs a measure word; 多少 asks any size and can drop the measure word. 二 is for counting/math, 两 is for quantities before measure words.
tip: Phone numbers read 1 as yāo: 13901… = yāo sān jiǔ líng yāo….

examples.chinese: 这个杯子十块钱。
examples.pinyin: zhège bēizi shí kuài qián.
examples.translation: This cup is 10 kuai.

examples.chinese: 今天几月几号？
examples.pinyin: jīntiān jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
examples.translation: What's the date today?

examples.chinese: 你们学校有多少学生？
examples.pinyin: nǐmen xuéxiào yǒu duōshao xuésheng?
examples.translation: How many students does your school have?

examples.chinese: 我家有两只猫。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng zhī māo.
examples.translation: My family has two cats.

quiz.question: 'How many people are in your family?' — small number expected:
quiz.explanation: Small numbers → 几 + measure word.

quiz.question: 22 yuan is read…
quiz.explanation: Inside numbers use 二; 两 only directly before measure words.

title: 应该 — should / ought to
structure: S + 应该 + V　|　应该…吧 (probably)
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 应该 gives advice ('should') and also guesses likelihood ('should be / probably'). Negative: 不应该.
tip: 多/少 + verb = do more / do less of it: 多休息, 少喝咖啡.

examples.chinese: 你应该多休息。
examples.pinyin: nǐ yīnggāi duō xiūxi.
examples.translation: You should rest more.

examples.chinese: 他现在应该到机场了吧。
examples.pinyin: tā xiànzài yīnggāi dào jīchǎng le ba.
examples.translation: He should have arrived at the airport by now.

examples.chinese: 学生不应该上课的时候玩手机。
examples.pinyin: xuésheng bù yīnggāi shàngkè de shíhou wán shǒujī.
examples.translation: Students shouldn't play with phones in class.

quiz.question: 'You shouldn't drink so much coffee' =
options: 你应该不喝这么多咖啡。
你不应该喝这么多咖啡。
你没应该喝这么多咖啡。
quiz.explanation: Negation goes before 应该: 不应该.

quiz.question: 他应该到了吧 means…
quiz.explanation: 应该…吧 = a confident guess.

title: Separable verbs 离合词
structure: V + (stuff) + O — 见面 → 见一次面
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Words like 见面, 帮忙, 睡觉, 起床, 跳舞, 唱歌, 游泳, 照相, 请假 are secretly verb + object. Anything extra (了, 过, 一次, time) squeezes into the middle — and they can't take another object after them: say 跟他见面, never 见面他.
tip: 'Met him' = 跟他见了面 / 见过他一次面 — the person goes BEFORE the verb with 跟.

examples.chinese: 我们明天见面吧。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen míngtiān jiànmiàn ba.
examples.translation: Let's meet tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 昨天我睡了十个小时的觉。
examples.pinyin: zuótiān wǒ shuì le shí ge xiǎoshí de jiào.
examples.translation: Yesterday I slept ten hours.

examples.chinese: 你能帮我一个忙吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yí ge máng ma?
examples.translation: Can you do me a favor?

quiz.question: Which is correct?
quiz.explanation: Separable verbs can't take objects after them; use 跟…见面.

quiz.question: 'danced twice' =
quiz.explanation: The count slips inside: 跳 + 了两次 + 舞.

title: 什么都 / 谁都 / 哪儿都 — any & every
titleVi: 什么都 / 谁都 / 哪儿都 — any & every
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: A question word + 都/也 stops being a question and means 'every-/any-': 什么都吃 eats everything, 什么都不吃 eats nothing, 谁都知道 everyone knows, 哪儿都不去 going nowhere.
tip: In negative sentences 也 can replace 都: 我什么也没买.

examples.chinese: 他什么都想买。
examples.pinyin: tā shénme dōu xiǎng mǎi.
examples.translation: He wants to buy everything.

examples.chinese: 明天我哪儿都不去。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān wǒ nǎr dōu bú qù.
examples.translation: Tomorrow I'm not going anywhere.

examples.chinese: 这件事谁都知道。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì shéi dōu zhīdào.
examples.translation: Everyone knows about this.

quiz.question: 'I'll eat anything' =
quiz.explanation: QW + 都 + verb.

quiz.question: 他谁都不认识 means…
quiz.explanation: 谁都不 + V = not…anyone.

title: 一下 vs 一会儿
structure: V + 一下 (quick action)　|　V + 一会儿 (short while)
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 一下 softens a verb into a quick, casual action ('have a look', 'wait a sec'). 一会儿 is an actual short duration ('for a bit'). 等一下 ≈ 等一会儿, but only 一会儿 works for real time spans: 睡一会儿.
tip: 一会儿 can also mean 'in a moment': 我一会儿给你打电话.

examples.chinese: 请等一下。
examples.pinyin: qǐng děng yíxià.
examples.translation: Please wait a moment.

examples.chinese: 我们休息一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen xiūxi yíhuìr ba.
examples.translation: Let's rest for a little while.

examples.chinese: 请你看一下这个句子。
examples.pinyin: qǐng nǐ kàn yíxià zhège jùzi.
examples.translation: Please take a look at this sentence.

quiz.question: 'sleep for a little while' =
quiz.explanation: Real duration needs 一会儿.

quiz.question: 请介绍___你们公司。
quiz.explanation: Quick casual action = V + 一下.

title: 才 — later / less than expected
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 才 complains that something is late, slow, or small: 十二点才睡 (only went to bed at 12!), 才学了三个月 (only studied 3 months). Sentences with 才 usually do NOT take 了 at the end.
tip: 才 = 'as late/little as', 就 = 'as early/much as'. Same sentence, opposite attitude.

examples.chinese: 他十二点才睡觉。
examples.pinyin: tā shí'èr diǎn cái shuìjiào.
examples.translation: He didn't go to bed until 12.

examples.chinese: 我才学了三个月汉语。
examples.pinyin: wǒ cái xué le sān ge yuè Hànyǔ.
examples.translation: I've only studied Chinese for three months.

examples.chinese: 电影八点才开始。
examples.pinyin: diànyǐng bā diǎn cái kāishǐ.
examples.translation: The movie doesn't start until eight.

quiz.question: 昨天他十一点___起床。(so lazy!)
quiz.explanation: Late + complaint = 才.

quiz.question: 我___来了五分钟。(I just got here)
quiz.explanation: 才 + small amount = only five minutes.

title: 才 vs 就
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 就 says it happened sooner/easier than expected; 才 says later/harder. 她五岁就会游泳了 (already at 5!) vs 他二十岁才学会 (not until 20). 就-sentences often end with 了, 才-sentences don't.
tip: Memory hook: 就 = jumps early, 才 = crawls late.

examples.chinese: 我六点就起床了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
examples.translation: I was already up at six.

examples.chinese: 他十点才起床。
examples.pinyin: tā shí diǎn cái qǐchuáng.
examples.translation: He didn't get up till ten.

examples.chinese: 她五岁就会游泳了。
examples.pinyin: tā wǔ suì jiù huì yóuyǒng le.
examples.translation: She could swim by age five.

quiz.question: 饭馆六点开门，他五点半___到了。
quiz.explanation: Earlier than needed = 就 (+了).

quiz.question: Which sentence sounds annoyed at slowness?
quiz.explanation: 才 = later than expected.

title: 还是 vs 或者 — two kinds of 'or'
titleVi: 还是 vs 或者 — two kinds of 'or'
structure: A 还是 B？ (question)　|　A 或者 B (statement)
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 还是 offers a choice in QUESTIONS: 茶还是咖啡？ 或者 lists options in STATEMENTS: 星期六或者星期天都行. One asks, the other tells.
tip: Inside an indirect question 还是 survives: 我不知道喝茶还是喝咖啡.

examples.chinese: 你喝茶还是咖啡？
examples.pinyin: nǐ hē chá háishi kāfēi?
examples.translation: Tea or coffee?

examples.chinese: 星期六或者星期天都可以。
examples.pinyin: xīngqīliù huòzhě xīngqītiān dōu kěyǐ.
examples.translation: Saturday or Sunday are both fine.

examples.chinese: 我们坐地铁或者公共汽车去。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zuò dìtiě huòzhě gōnggòng qìchē qù.
examples.translation: We'll go by metro or by bus.

quiz.question: 明天___后天，我都有时间。
quiz.explanation: Statement 'or' = 或者.

quiz.question: 你想去北京___上海？
quiz.explanation: A-or-B question = 还是.

title: 的 / 得 / 地 — the three de
titleVi: 的 / 得 / 地 — the three de
structure: Adj + 的 + Noun　|　V + 得 + how　|　Adj + 地 + V
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: All three sound 'de'. 的 glues a description to a NOUN (新买的手机). 得 comes AFTER a verb to grade it (跑得很快). 地 turns an adjective into a HOW before the verb (高兴地说). Exam favorite!
tip: Test trick: …得 + 很/真/非常 → must be 得. Before the verb describing manner → 地. Before a noun → 的.

examples.chinese: 这是我新买的手机。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ xīn mǎi de shǒujī.
examples.translation: This is the phone I just bought.

examples.chinese: 他跑得很快。
examples.pinyin: tā pǎo de hěn kuài.
examples.translation: He runs very fast.

examples.chinese: 她高兴地说：“欢迎你们！”
examples.pinyin: tā gāoxìng de shuō: “huānyíng nǐmen!”
examples.translation: She said happily: 'Welcome!'

quiz.question: 他高兴___跳了起来。
quiz.explanation: Adjective + 地 + verb = manner.

quiz.question: 她唱___非常好。
quiz.explanation: Verb + 得 + degree.

title: 又 vs 再 vs 还 — again, three ways
titleVi: 又 vs 再 vs 还 — again, three ways
structure: 又 + V + 了 (happened again)　|　再 + V (will again)　|　还要/还想 + V (want more)
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 又 = it already happened again (past, with 了). 再 = do it again in the future (欢迎再来). 还 = the wish/state continues (我还想看). 又 looks back, 再 looks forward, 还 keeps going.
tip: 再 pairs with commands and future; 又 pairs with 了.

examples.chinese: 他昨天来了，今天又来了。
examples.pinyin: tā zuótiān lái le, jīntiān yòu lái le.
examples.translation: He came yesterday and came again today.

examples.chinese: 欢迎你再来！
examples.pinyin: huānyíng nǐ zài lái!
examples.translation: Welcome back again!

examples.chinese: 这个电影我还想再看一次。
examples.pinyin: zhège diànyǐng wǒ hái xiǎng zài kàn yí cì.
examples.translation: I want to watch this movie once more.

quiz.question: 明天___说吧。(let's talk again tomorrow)
quiz.explanation: Future repeat = 再.

quiz.question: 他今天早上___迟到了。
quiz.explanation: Past repetition with 了 = 又.

title: 除了…(以外) — except / besides
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: With 都: A is excluded (除了小王，我们都去 = everyone EXCEPT him). With 也/还: A is included and more is added (除了苹果，还喜欢香蕉 = BESIDES apples, also bananas). The little adverb decides the meaning.
tip: See 都 → 'except'. See 也/还 → 'besides'.

examples.chinese: 除了小王，我们都去了。
examples.pinyin: chúle Xiǎo Wáng, wǒmen dōu qù le.
examples.translation: Except for Xiao Wang, we all went.

examples.chinese: 除了苹果，他还喜欢香蕉。
examples.pinyin: chúle píngguǒ, tā hái xǐhuan xiāngjiāo.
examples.translation: Besides apples, he also likes bananas.

examples.chinese: 除了跳舞，她还喜欢唱歌。
examples.pinyin: chúle tiàowǔ, tā hái xǐhuan chànggē.
examples.translation: Besides dancing, she also likes singing.

quiz.question: 除了他，别人___不知道。
quiz.explanation: Exclusion reading takes 都.

quiz.question: 除了汉语，他___会说日语 means he speaks…
quiz.explanation: 除了…还 = besides A, also B (both true).

title: 着 — ongoing states
structure: V + 着 (state continues)　|　V1着 V1着…
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 着 freezes a verb into a lasting state: 门开着 (the door stands open), 拿着伞 (holding an umbrella). It also paints the background of another action: 笑着说 said while smiling. Existence pattern: Place + V着 + thing (桌子上放着几本书).
tip: 着 = a paused video frame; 正在 = the video playing. 穿着红衣服 describes the state, not the action of dressing.

examples.chinese: 门开着呢。
examples.pinyin: mén kāi zhe ne.
examples.translation: The door is open.

examples.chinese: 他笑着说：“没关系。”
examples.pinyin: tā xiào zhe shuō: “méi guānxi.”
examples.translation: He said with a smile: 'It doesn't matter.'

examples.chinese: 桌子上放着几本书。
examples.pinyin: zhuōzi shang fàng zhe jǐ běn shū.
examples.translation: A few books are lying on the table.

quiz.question: 外面下___大雨，别出去了。
quiz.explanation: Ongoing background state = V + 着.

quiz.question: 他听___音乐做作业。
quiz.explanation: V1着 + V2: doing homework while music plays.

title: 把 sentences I — moving the object up front
titleVi: 把 sentences I — moving the object up front
structure: S + 把 + O + V + 了/complement
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 把 drags the object in front of the verb to say what you DID to it. The verb can never stand alone — it must carry something after it: 了, 完, 好, 上, 到… 我把作业做完了, never 我把作业做.
tip: The 把-object must be specific/known (THE homework, not 'some homework'). Negation goes before 把: 我没把作业做完.

examples.chinese: 我把作业做完了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ zuòyè zuò wán le.
examples.translation: I finished the homework.

examples.chinese: 请把门关上。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ mén guān shang.
examples.translation: Please close the door.

examples.chinese: 他把咖啡喝了。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ kāfēi hē le.
examples.translation: He drank up the coffee.

quiz.question: Which is a valid 把 sentence?
quiz.explanation: The verb needs a result after it: 吃完了.

quiz.question: Negate 他把灯关了:
quiz.explanation: 没/别/不 stand BEFORE 把.

title: 把 sentences II — 给 / 到 / 在
titleVi: 把 sentences II — 给 / 到 / 在
structure: 把 + O + V + 给 sb / 到 place / 在 place
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Use 把 whenever you hand, move, or place something: 把书给他 (give it to him), 把车开到公司 (drive it TO…), 把手机放在桌子上 (put it ON…). With 给/到/在 the 把-structure is practically mandatory.
tip: V + 到/在/给 + place/person glues tightly to the verb — this is why the object must move up front with 把.

examples.chinese: 请把这本书给他。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhè běn shū gěi tā.
examples.translation: Please give this book to him.

examples.chinese: 我把车开到公司了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ chē kāi dào gōngsī le.
examples.translation: I drove the car to the office.

examples.chinese: 别把手机放在床上。
examples.pinyin: bié bǎ shǒujī fàng zài chuáng shang.
examples.translation: Don't put your phone on the bed.

quiz.question: 'Put the luggage in the room' =
quiz.explanation: Placement = 把 + O + 放在 + place.

quiz.question: 请___这杯茶给奶奶。
quiz.explanation: Handing something over = 把…给…

title: 被 — the passive
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 被 marks that the subject got acted ON — often unpleasantly: 蛋糕被弟弟吃了. The doer can be dropped: 我的伞被借走了. Like 把, the verb needs a tail (了/走/完…). Negation before 被: 还没被发现.
tip: 把 aims forward (I did X to it); 被 receives (it got X-ed). Same verb-needs-a-result rule.

examples.chinese: 我的蛋糕被弟弟吃了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de dàngāo bèi dìdi chī le.
examples.translation: My cake got eaten by my little brother.

examples.chinese: 我的伞被同学借走了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de sǎn bèi tóngxué jiè zǒu le.
examples.translation: My umbrella was borrowed (taken) by a classmate.

examples.chinese: 我的自行车被人骑走了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de zìxíngchē bèi rén qí zǒu le.
examples.translation: Someone rode off on my bike.

quiz.question: 我的咖啡___猫打了。
quiz.explanation: Subject suffers the action → 被.

quiz.question: Turn 弟弟把蛋糕吃了 into passive:
quiz.explanation: Receiver + 被 + doer + V + 了.

title: 跟…一样 vs 像…一样
titleVi: 跟…一样 vs 像…一样
structure: A 跟 B 一样 (+Adj)　|　A 像 B 一样 (+Adj)
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 跟…一样 = exactly the same (我的爱好跟你一样). 像…一样 = resembles, 'like' a simile (像公园一样漂亮). Negation: 跟…不一样.
tip: Identical twins use 跟; poetic comparisons use 像.

examples.chinese: 我的爱好跟你一样。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de àihào gēn nǐ yíyàng.
examples.translation: My hobbies are the same as yours.

examples.chinese: 他跟爸爸一样高。
examples.pinyin: tā gēn bàba yíyàng gāo.
examples.translation: He is as tall as his dad.

examples.chinese: 这个地方像公园一样漂亮。
examples.pinyin: zhège dìfang xiàng gōngyuán yíyàng piàoliang.
examples.translation: This place is as pretty as a park.

quiz.question: 今天热得___夏天一样。
quiz.explanation: Simile/resemblance = 像…一样.

quiz.question: 'My phone is the same as his' =
quiz.explanation: Real sameness = 跟…一样.

title: 越…越… / 越来越…
structure: 越 V1 越 Adj　|　越来越 + Adj
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 越A越B = the more A, the more B (雨越下越大). 越来越 = getting more and more over TIME (天气越来越热). No 很/非常 after them — the pattern already contains the degree.
tip: 越来越很热 ✗ — never add 很.

examples.chinese: 雨越下越大。
examples.pinyin: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà.
examples.translation: The rain is getting heavier and heavier.

examples.chinese: 天气越来越热了。
examples.pinyin: tiānqì yuèláiyuè rè le.
examples.translation: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

examples.chinese: 汉语我越学越觉得有意思。
examples.pinyin: Hànyǔ wǒ yuè xué yuè juéde yǒu yìsi.
examples.translation: The more I study Chinese, the more interesting I find it.

quiz.question: 他跑得___快。(faster and faster)
quiz.explanation: Change over time = 越来越 + adj.

quiz.question: Which is wrong?
quiz.explanation: 很 can't follow 越来越.

title: Rhetorical questions 反问句
structure: 不是…吗？　|　谁不…？　|　怎么会…？
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: A question that isn't asking — it's insisting. 你不是去过北京吗？ = you HAVE been to Beijing. 谁不知道？ = everyone knows. 怎么可能？ = impossible! On the exam, read these as strong statements, not questions.
tip: Listening trap: 不是…吗 sounds negative but means an emphatic YES.

examples.chinese: 这么简单的问题，谁不会呢？
examples.pinyin: zhème jiǎndān de wèntí, shéi bú huì ne?
examples.translation: Such a simple question — who wouldn't know it?

examples.chinese: 你不是去过北京吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ bú shì qùguo Běijīng ma?
examples.translation: Haven't you been to Beijing (you have)!

examples.chinese: 他怎么可能不知道？
examples.pinyin: tā zěnme kěnéng bù zhīdào?
examples.translation: How could he possibly not know?

quiz.question: 你不是已经吃过饭了吗？ The speaker thinks…
quiz.explanation: Rhetorical 不是…吗 asserts the positive.

quiz.question: 谁想迟到呢？ means…
quiz.explanation: Rhetorical 谁 = no one.

title: Directional complements 上/下/进/出/回/过/起 + 来/去
titleVi: Directional complements 上/下/进/出/回/过/起 + 来/去
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 来 = toward the speaker, 去 = away. Stack directions on verbs: 走出来 walk out (toward me), 拿上去 carry up (away). Places squeeze before 来/去: 走进教室去. Objects often do too: 拿出一本书来.
tip: Where are YOU? If it moves toward you → 来; away from you → 去.

examples.chinese: 他从办公室走出来了。
examples.pinyin: tā cóng bàngōngshì zǒu chūlai le.
examples.translation: He walked out of the office (toward me).

examples.chinese: 你快进来吧！
examples.pinyin: nǐ kuài jìnlai ba!
examples.translation: Come on in!

examples.chinese: 他把行李箱拿上去了。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ xínglixiāng ná shàngqu le.
examples.translation: He carried the suitcase up.

quiz.question: You're downstairs; your friend is upstairs and you shout 'come down':
quiz.explanation: Moving toward the speaker = 来.

quiz.question: 他走___教室去了。(into)
quiz.explanation: 走进 + place + 去 = walked into.

title: 一…就… — as soon as
structure: S 一 V1 就 V2　|　A 一 V1，B 就 V2
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: The instant A happens, B follows: 我一到家就给你打电话. Also for habits: 他一高兴就唱歌 (whenever he's happy, he sings).
tip: Two different subjects are fine: 老师一进来，学生们就安静了.

examples.chinese: 我一到家就给你打电话。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yí dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.translation: I'll call you as soon as I get home.

examples.chinese: 他一高兴就唱歌。
examples.pinyin: tā yì gāoxìng jiù chànggē.
examples.translation: Whenever he's happy he sings.

examples.chinese: 她一看书就想睡觉。
examples.pinyin: tā yí kàn shū jiù xiǎng shuìjiào.
examples.translation: As soon as she starts reading she gets sleepy.

quiz.question: 我___下课___去找你。
quiz.explanation: 一 + first event, 就 + immediate second.

quiz.question: 他一喝咖啡就睡不着 means…
quiz.explanation: Habitual 一…就…: whenever A, B.

title: 不但…而且… — not only…but also
titleVi: 不但…而且… — not only…but also
structure: S 不但 A，而且(还/也) B
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Stacks two qualities, the second stronger: 不但大，而且很干净. Same subject → subject before 不但. Different subjects → each clause gets its own: 不但我会，而且他也会.
tip: 而且 often teams with 还/也: 不但…而且还….

examples.chinese: 这个房间不但大，而且很干净。
examples.pinyin: zhège fángjiān búdàn dà, érqiě hěn gānjìng.
examples.translation: This room is not only big but also clean.

examples.chinese: 他不但会游泳，而且游得很好。
examples.pinyin: tā búdàn huì yóuyǒng, érqiě yóu de hěn hǎo.
examples.translation: He can not only swim, he swims well.

examples.chinese: 不但我同意，而且大家都同意。
examples.pinyin: búdàn wǒ tóngyì, érqiě dàjiā dōu tóngyì.
examples.translation: Not only I agree — everyone does.

quiz.question: 这家饭馆的菜不但好吃，___很便宜。
quiz.explanation: 不但 pairs with 而且.

quiz.question: Same subject — where does it go?
quiz.explanation: Same subject stands before 不但.

title: 就是 — 'the only thing is…'
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 就是 introduces the one catch after praise: 这个手机什么都好，就是太贵了. Also plain emphasis: 我就是不想去 (I simply don't want to).
tip: Pattern radar: praise + 就是 + complaint = mild 'but'.

examples.chinese: 这个手机什么都好，就是太贵了。
examples.pinyin: zhège shǒujī shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì tài guì le.
examples.translation: This phone is great in every way — it's just too expensive.

examples.chinese: 那家饭馆菜很好吃，就是人太多。
examples.pinyin: nà jiā fànguǎn cài hěn hǎochī, jiùshì rén tài duō.
examples.translation: That restaurant's food is great, only it's too crowded.

examples.chinese: 我就是不想去。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiùshì bù xiǎng qù.
examples.translation: I just don't want to go.

quiz.question: 这条裙子很漂亮，___有点儿短。
quiz.explanation: One drawback after praise = 就是.

quiz.question: 我就是不去！expresses…
quiz.explanation: 就是 + refusal = simply/just.

title: 如果…就… — if…then
structure: 如果 A（的话），S 就 B
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: 如果 opens the condition, 就 delivers the result: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了. 的话 can tag along after the condition. 要是 is the spoken twin of 如果.
tip: 就 stays AFTER the second subject: 我们就…, never 就我们….

examples.chinese: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.pinyin: rúguǒ míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù páshān le.
examples.translation: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

examples.chinese: 如果你有时间，就来我家玩儿吧。
examples.pinyin: rúguǒ nǐ yǒu shíjiān, jiù lái wǒ jiā wánr ba.
examples.translation: If you have time, come over to my place.

examples.chinese: 如果你不舒服的话，就去医院看看。
examples.pinyin: rúguǒ nǐ bù shūfu dehuà, jiù qù yīyuàn kànkan.
examples.translation: If you don't feel well, go see a doctor.

quiz.question: 如果你喜欢，我___送给你。
quiz.explanation: Result clause takes 就.

quiz.question: Where does 就 go?
quiz.explanation: Subject + 就 + verb.

title: 只有…才… — only if
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: The ONLY road to the result: 只有多练习，才能学好汉语. Compare 只要…就… (any time the condition holds, result follows — easier condition). 只有 is strict, 只要 is generous.
tip: 只有 pairs with 才 (hard gate); 只要 pairs with 就 (easy gate).

examples.chinese: 只有多练习，你才能学好汉语。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu duō liànxí, nǐ cái néng xué hǎo Hànyǔ.
examples.translation: Only with lots of practice can you master Chinese.

examples.chinese: 只有周末，他才有时间锻炼。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu zhōumò, tā cái yǒu shíjiān duànliàn.
examples.translation: Only on weekends does he have time to exercise.

examples.chinese: 只有努力工作，才能提高水平。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu nǔlì gōngzuò, cái néng tígāo shuǐpíng.
examples.translation: Only by working hard can you raise your level.

quiz.question: 只有他同意，我们___能开始。
quiz.explanation: 只有…才… is a fixed pair.

quiz.question: 'As long as you call, I'll come' uses…
quiz.explanation: Generous condition = 只要…就….

title: 一 + MW + 都/也 + 不/没 — not even one
titleVi: 一 + MW + 都/也 + 不/没 — not even one
structure: S + 一 + measure + Noun + 都/也 + 不/没 + V
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Total, dramatic negation: 一个人都没有 (not a single person), 一点儿也不饿 (not hungry at all), 一句话也没说 (didn't say one word).
tip: Pick the noun's own measure word: 一本书都没看, 一杯水都没喝.

examples.chinese: 我一点儿也不饿。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yìdiǎnr yě bú è.
examples.translation: I'm not hungry at all.

examples.chinese: 教室里一个人都没有。
examples.pinyin: jiàoshì li yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu.
examples.translation: There isn't a single person in the classroom.

examples.chinese: 他一句话也没说。
examples.pinyin: tā yí jù huà yě méi shuō.
examples.translation: He didn't say a single word.

quiz.question: 我今天___钱都没花。(not a single kuai)
quiz.explanation: Money counts with 块.

quiz.question: 他一点儿也不累 means…
quiz.explanation: 一点儿也不 = not at all.

title: 又…又… — both…and
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Two qualities at the same time, both bare (no 很): 又便宜又好吃. Works for verbs too: 又会唱歌又会跳舞.
tip: 又…又… = both at once; 一边…一边… = two ACTIONS in parallel. Qualities → 又, actions → 一边.

examples.chinese: 这种水果又便宜又好吃。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.translation: This fruit is both cheap and tasty.

examples.chinese: 他工作又快又认真。
examples.pinyin: tā gōngzuò yòu kuài yòu rènzhēn.
examples.translation: He works fast and conscientiously.

examples.chinese: 妹妹又聪明又可爱。
examples.pinyin: mèimei yòu cōngming yòu kě'ài.
examples.translation: Little sister is both clever and cute.

quiz.question: 这个房间___大___干净。
quiz.explanation: Paired qualities = 又…又….

quiz.question: Which is wrong?
quiz.explanation: No 很 inside 又…又….

title: 一边…一边… — doing two things at once
titleVi: 一边…一边… — doing two things at once
structure: S + 一边 V1 + 一边 V2
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: Two actions running in parallel: 一边吃饭一边看电视. Both verbs belong to the same subject and happen simultaneously.
tip: States use 着 instead: 站着吃饭 (eat standing), not 一边站一边吃.

examples.chinese: 他喜欢一边吃饭一边看电视。
examples.pinyin: tā xǐhuan yìbiān chīfàn yìbiān kàn diànshì.
examples.translation: He likes to watch TV while eating.

examples.chinese: 我一边听音乐一边做作业。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yìbiān tīng yīnyuè yìbiān zuò zuòyè.
examples.translation: I do homework while listening to music.

examples.chinese: 别一边开车一边打电话。
examples.pinyin: bié yìbiān kāichē yìbiān dǎ diànhuà.
examples.translation: Don't phone while driving.

quiz.question: 她___唱歌___跳舞。
quiz.explanation: Two simultaneous actions = 一边…一边….

quiz.question: Which combination is most natural?
options: 一边是学生一边是老师
quiz.explanation: 一边 links ongoing actions, not qualities/identities.

title: Result complements: V + 完/好/到/见/错/懂/会
titleVi: Result complements: V + 完/好/到/见/错/懂/会
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: The second syllable reports the OUTCOME: 写完 finished writing, 听懂 understood by listening, 找到 found, 看见 saw, 写错 wrote wrong, 学会 mastered. Negate the outcome with 没: 没听懂. Possibility form: 听得懂 / 听不懂.
tip: 得/不 squeeze inside for can/can't: 看得见 can see it, 看不见 can't see it.

examples.chinese: 作业我写完了。
examples.pinyin: zuòyè wǒ xiě wán le.
examples.translation: I've finished writing the homework.

examples.chinese: 你听懂了吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ tīng dǒng le ma?
examples.translation: Did you understand (what you heard)?

examples.chinese: 我没找到我的眼镜。
examples.pinyin: wǒ méi zhǎo dào wǒ de yǎnjìng.
examples.translation: I couldn't find my glasses.

quiz.question: 黑板上的字我看不___。(can't see clearly… too far)
quiz.explanation: 看见 = perceive; 看不见 = can't see.

title: Duration: V + 了 + time (+ 了)
titleVi: Duration: V + 了 + time (+ 了)
structure: V了 + duration　|　V了 + duration + 了 (still going)
usedFor: Ngữ pháp trọng điểm & bài tập trắc nghiệm
explanation: How long something lasted: 住了三年 (lived 3 years, over). Add a final 了 and it's still running: 学了一年了 (a year so far, still learning). With objects: 学了一年（的）汉语 or 学汉语学了一年.
tip: One 了 = finished chapter; two 了 = story still open.

examples.chinese: 我学汉语学了一年了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xué Hànyǔ xué le yì nián le.
examples.translation: I've been studying Chinese for a year (and counting).

examples.chinese: 他在北京住了三年。
examples.pinyin: tā zài Běijīng zhù le sān nián.
examples.translation: He lived in Beijing for three years.

examples.chinese: 我们等了他半个小时。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen děng le tā bàn ge xiǎoshí.
examples.translation: We waited for him for half an hour.

quiz.question: 我学了两年汉语了 means…
quiz.explanation: V了…时间…了 = continues up to now.
